Intake note - Property team
Date: 24 November 2021
Client: Mohan Sandhu, a 62-year-old electrician from Chennai.
Address: House No. 123, Anna Nagar, Chennai 600042
Phone: 06926818780. Email: mohan.sandhu@example.com. PAN VWDPS1315J.
Matter: consumer complaint
Opposing party: M/s Goyal Developers
Facts: The consumer complaint against Goyal Developers concerns a flat bought for Rs 3,26,00,000; the builder keeps promising possession by email but never delivers.
The matter was filed as CC/57/2022 before the Chennai District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission on 31 March 2022.
